ValidationRule.description: This validation will restrict user to change receipt status after it has been marked as bounced
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISPICKVAL(Receipt_Status__c, "Bounced"), ISPICKVAL(Receipt_Status__c, "Cancelled") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Receipt_Status__c), "Bounced"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Receipt_Status__c), "Cancelled") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot modify this payment receipt as receipt status is bounced/cancelled
